# PrettyVision — Optometrist • Opticians • Contact Lens Clinic

> Premium optical showroom and eye care clinic located in Kalina, Santacruz East, Mumbai. Providing authentic luxury eyewear brands (Ray-Ban, Oakley, Vogue, Armani, etc.), computerized eye tests, and customized prescription glasses.

- Canonical Website: https://prettyvision.in
- Sitemap: https://prettyvision.in/sitemap.xml
- Store Address: Shop No 11, Agarwal Building, Market, opposite Nilesh Dryfruits, Kolivery Village, Vidya Nagari, Kalina, Santacruz East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400098
- Phone: 095940 30310
- Hours: Monday – Saturday: 10:00 AM – 9:30 PM | Sunday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM

## Iconic Designer Brands
- [Ray-Ban](https://prettyvision.in/brands/ray-ban): Iconic global eyewear brand famous for the Aviator, Wayfarer, Clubmaster and Meta smart glasses.
- [Oakley](https://prettyvision.in/brands/oakley): Pioneering high-performance sport optics and stylish casual eyewear for outdoor enthusiasts.
- [Vogue Eyewear](https://prettyvision.in/brands/vogue-eyewear): Trendy, expressive and fashion-forward frames tailored for contemporary women and men.
- [Emporio Armani](https://prettyvision.in/brands/emporio-armani): Refined Italian luxury and modern elegance crafted with exceptional precision.
- [Versace](https://prettyvision.in/brands/versace): Glamorous Italian high-fashion eyewear with unmistakable Medusa motifs and opulent designs.
- [Tom Ford](https://prettyvision.in/brands/tom-ford): Sophisticated luxury acetate and metal frames recognized by the signature elegant 'T' temple logo.
- [Essilor](https://prettyvision.in/brands/essilor): World leader in ophthalmic lens technology, Varilux progressive lenses and Crizal anti-reflective coatings.
- [Polaroid](https://prettyvision.in/brands/polaroid): The pioneers of polarized lens technology, bringing crisp contrast and 100% UV protection.
